results.title: Tulpiniai: A Fatal Mistake
results.overview: This documentary film tells the story of one of Lithuania's most brutal criminal gangs—the "Tulpiniai"—and the efforts of law enforcement officials to put a stop to its activities.

results.title: A Mass for Dom Angélico
results.overview: Dom Angélico was born into a poor family and distinguished himself by supporting the social movements that emerged in the late 1950s. He was the bishop of the oppressed and of the protest marches, a champion of the struggle for better housing and living conditions for workers. He led crowds at masses dedicated to human rights. In the realm of journalism, he kept communities informed through *Grita Povo*. Persecuted by the military dictatorship, he confronted the police and faced repeated arrests and threats, yet he never fell silent. Dom Angélico lived for 92 years, believing it possible to unite faith in God with political action for a better world.

results.title: Acid Rain: Stories from Crepúsculo de Cubatão
results.original_title: Chuva Ácida: Histórias do Crepúsculo de Cubatão
results.overview: A documentary that brings together personal memories and rare footage of the nightclub that operated in Copacabana from 1984 to 1989. Featuring interviews with DJs, staff, and patrons of Crepúsculo de Cubatão, the film explores the influence of British culture on the music and behavior of young people who were then labeled “darks.” More than simply telling the story of a venue, the documentary reveals the origins and behind-the-scenes dynamics of the vibrant cultural scene in Rio de Janeiro that emerged during Brazil’s political opening.

results.title: Ultorath
results.overview: Three generations confront conflict under one roof until one incident bridges their divide, proving patience and understanding can transform relationships.

results.title: Until The Last Sunshine
results.overview: An aspiring cinematographer meets a young artist at St. Thomas Mount in Chennai, where their shared love for art and sunsets slowly brings them closer. But when he leaves the city to pursue a long-awaited opportunity, their promise to meet again takes an unexpected turn.

results.title: Placenta
results.overview: Under grotesque, clinical observation, four androgynous subjects homogenize one another under the gaze of a passive reflector.

results.title: Schumacher ’94 – The Birth of a Legend
results.overview: Michael Schumacher's first World Championship win roars to life through personal interviews and archival footage of the legendary 1994 Formula 1 season.

results.title: Street Fighters
results.overview: The world’s best martial artists come together for a world championship organised by a mysterious organisation. As alliances are forged and enemies emerge, they soon realise there’s more at stake than the grand prize… their lives!

results.title: Powered by Blood
results.overview: A poetic documentary that immerses itself in the nocturnal world of food delivery app workers, where the relentless pace of this work routine twists and distorts both the workers' bodies and perceptions and their rhetoric of labor liberation.

results.title: A Special Day
results.overview: A seemingly normal family home movie is interrupted by a shocking event.

results.title: Temporary Death
results.overview: A man films his second attempt at taking his own life as part of a dangerous experiment. After surviving his first death and inexplicably returning as someone else, he believes he can control who he becomes next. With two friends documenting everything under strict orders not to intervene, the experiment quickly spirals into something far more horrifying than any of them expected.

results.title: Kill Okiharu's Tears
results.original_title: 沖晴くんの涙を殺して
results.overview: A woman with one year left to live meets a high school student who has lost all emotions other than joy.

results.title: CAMPEÓN
results.overview: Emma's life violently unravels as she is both the obsession of a narcissistic addict, and the fault line between identical brothers.

results.title: Backpay
results.overview: Backpay follows Steve, a desperate father fighting to save his marriage, who teams up with Murphy, a cop scarred by life as an informant. Their “simple” extortion plot—kidnap a corrupt politician and crack a safe—quickly spirals into danger.

results.title: The True Spirit
results.overview: The story begins with the boxing lives of two urban Indigenous youths, Liu Li-Chen and Su Jing-Wen. Gifted with exceptional talent, Li-Chen won a national championship in junior high school, only to fall into confusion after entering high school—caught between boxing, academic expectations, and his Indigenous identity. As he struggles to find his path, his performance in the ring declines, dealing a heavy blow to his confidence. Jing-Wen, from the Nanjing Indigenous community in Sanxia, New Taipei City, is seen as a promising Olympic boxer of her generation. Yet deep down, she is uncertain about her future in boxing. The only reason she continues training is the weight of others’ expectations. Despite growing up in an urban Indigenous community, she finds no real sense of belonging in the city.

results.title: Lonely Boy
results.overview: An extremely lonely man enters an online friendship with a serial killer.

results.title: Bhootu Aaya Bhago
results.overview: Three friends find themselves trapped in a series of mysterious and supernatural incidents inside a hospital.
